posts.title: Leave it to know if you should stay
posts.description: Leave it to know if you should stay I've left whatsapp and google behind recently, and the experience has been insightful. When leaving whatsapp, I tried to make a backup of my conversations, but that required a slow manual manipulation to be performed for each conversation one by one on mobile.
